<i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i> is broken into three <b>Acts</b>, each denoted by an introductory title card. Each Act has its own set of story <b>objectives</b> that Hornet must complete to progress to the next Act (except in the case of the <i>[[#The Threadspun Town|SAVE: The Threadspun Town]]</i>, <i>[[#Grand Gate|OPEN: Grand Gate]]</i> and <i>[[SEARCH: Silent Halls]]</i> objectives). Ongoing objectives appear on the [[Tasks]] menu in the [[Controls (Silksong)|INVENTORY]].

== Act 1: Pharloom ==
The first Act of the game begins directly after the opening cutscene, and focuses on [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]'s journey to [[the Citadel]]. Hornet acquires her first objective after speaking to the [[Chapel Maid]].

== Act 2: Citadel of Song ==
The second Act begins upon entering the Citadel after defeating the [[Last Judge]] or [[Phantom]]. Hornet must explore the Citadel and learn the [[Threefold Melody]] to reach the very top of the kingdom, known as [[the Cradle]]. When achieving the <i>[[Endings (Silksong)#Ending 1: Weaver Queen|Weaver Queen]]</i> or <i>[[Endings (Silksong)#Ending 3: Twisted Child|Twisted Child]]</i> endings, Act 2 is the final act of the game.

== Act 3: Abyss ==
Entering the third Act requires completing the <i>[[Silk and Soul]]</i> [[Wishes|wish]] and subsequently defeating [[Grand Mother Silk]] with the [[Needolin]]. After the  <i>[[Endings (Silksong)#Ending 2: Snared Silk|Snared Silk]]</i> ending and credits, the [[Save Data (Silksong)|save profile]] gets covered with black threads, and after a few presses on it, the profile can be reopened to begin Act 3.

[[Pharloom]] has been infected with the [[Void]], and Hornet must journey into Pharloom's [[The Abyss (Silksong)|Abyss]] to confront Grand Mother Silk alongside [[Lace]]. Completing Act 3's main questline and defeating its final boss, [[Lost Lace]], concludes the final ending of <i>Hollow Knight: Silksong</i>.

=== Notable Changes ===
Several major changes occur when entering Act 3:
* Various passageways are blocked off and new ones become accessible.
* Various enemies and bosses can become [[Black-Threading|afflicted by the Void]], enhancing their movesets, health, and attacks.
* [[Void Mass|Void Masses]] spawn.
* [[Bone Bottom]] is almost completely destroyed, with only the [[Bellway]] remaining. A [[Survivor's Camp]] is erected in [[the Marrow]] where the Flea Caravan used to be.
* The [[Wormways]] become overrun with [[Lifeblood|Plasmium]].
* Haunted enemies no longer have a visible "puppet string" effect when they react to the [[Needolin]]. (The sound cue still plays.)

==Creation and Development==
According to the ''Bloomberg News'' journalist Jason Schreier, who met and interviewed [[Team Cherry]] in August and November 2025, Team Cherry "''always knew [Silksong] was going to be this upward journey from Pharloom to the Citadel and then to the Abyss where the world is destroyed. They knew it was going to have these three acts.''" Schreier also said that they "''worked on each act successively''", and that doing so "''helped them kind of have this structure in their minds and make it feel more fun''".<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Vh81qNGpHnc Why Hollow Knight: Silksong Took Seven Years To Make] on YouTube</ref> This is supported by Gibson being quoted in the November interview as saying "''Act 3 stuff we worked on at the very end. But all of those areas we knew were going to exist, or were slated to exist.''"<ref name="interview" /> The Abyss and other Act 3-exclusive content first started appearing in maps dated to 2022.<ref>[https://hollowknight.wiki/w/Cut_Content_(Silksong)#Gallery Early <i>Hollow Knight: Silksong</i> Maps]</ref> However, [[William Pellen]] is quoted in the interview as saying that the Abyss postgame was conceptualized before Acts were formally named, possibly implying they initially only internally existed.<ref name="interview">[https://www.bloomberg.com/news/newsletters/2025-11-28/the-makers-of-hollow-knight-silksong-aren-t-done-just-yet The Makers of 'Silksong' Aren't Done Just Yet]</ref> Additionally, Act 3 was much harder prior to release, getting its difficulty later reduced for balancing reasons.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DBvt0maVetE&t=19330s Live stream VOD discussing conversation with Matthew Griffin] (5:22:10)</ref>
